entities.summary: George Jesse Hill Jr. is an American former professional basketball player who played for eight teams over 15 seasons in the National Basketball Association (NBA). While playing for Indiana University–Purdue University Indianapolis (IUPUI), he was named Summit League Player of the Year and was an honorable mention All-American in his junior season.
